steps: In a large bowl, whisk the wheat flour with the baking powder.
In a jug, beat the eggs with the cow's milk.
Pour the milk mixture over the flour and whisk just until smooth; a few small lumps are fine. Rest 5 minutes.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and brush it with a little of the canola oil, about 30 seconds, until it shimmers.
Pour 60 ml of batter per pancake. Cook 2 minutes, until bubbles form on top and the edges look set.
Flip and cook 1 to 2 minutes more, until golden underneath. Oil the pan again between batches.
Cut into strips for a baby, quarters for a toddler. Freeze between sheets of parchment, up to 1 month.
